$comment: Central model-tier policy shared by hyperresearch orchestration and rpiv workflows. Tiers are COST bands (small/medium/large); membership is Pareto-driven: a model belongs to a tier when it meets that tier's measured quality bar at that tier's cost. Stages map to tiers; tiers resolve to host-opaque model keys (provider/id or host alias) per executing host.

small.description: Mechanical extraction: fetch notes, pull claims, parse pairs, score readability. Schema-following work where failure is visible (parse errors, empty fields). Anchor cost class: haiku.

requires.validator: deterministic schema check + 1 retry, then escalate

medium.description: Coherent assembly: loci analysis, evidence digests, draft variants, polish application. Needs multi-part instruction following; drafts are redundant by design. Anchor cost class: sonnet.

large.description: Verdicts that stick: depth investigation, critics, synthesis, saw review, final assembly, sampled cite-check adjudication. Every quality call in the 2026-10-20 run came from this tier. Anchor cost class: opus.

requires.validator: none cheaper — this tier IS the validator

pi.$comment: Pi harness host: 15+ providers, mid-session switching. Bare aliases resolve through Pi's registry.

praxis.$comment: Headless Claude-Code runner (claude-host.ts claudeModel): provider/id keys accepted but non-anthropic providers throw — effectively Anthropic-only on this host. Note: rpiv-wf run honors --model as the run-wide default with pack per-stage pins overriding (cli.ts).

candidates.thesis: Performs comparably to opus-class on extract-shaped work at haiku-class cost — i.e. a Pareto break: large-tier quality at small-tier price on mechanical stages.
candidates.e1: ds-flash recall 0.66 (R1 full harness) / 0.59 (R2 lean harness) / 0.71 (R3 bare API) / 0.65 (R4 bare API + lean system message). Verdict: run BARE via direct API, no system message, validator + 1 retry (1 garble in 60 trials). Any preamble costs ~0.06 recall on this model. ds-flash-1017: 0.69/0.62/0.68/0.66 — best harnessed, container drift only via pi --system-prompt path. 5 notes, 38 reference claims, threshold fixed pre-run. Artifacts: /tmp/e1cheap (scratch).

candidates.notes: Base llama-3-8b is DISQUALIFIED for fetch: 8k context cannot fit full pages. 128k variants clear the context floor; unproven: structured-output reliability and extraction recall. Local Ollama attractive at volume (~$0 marginal, private); throughput is the tradeoff.

hyperresearch.$comment: Step name -> tier for the 16-step research pipeline. saw is the subtract step (synthesis -> saw -> citecheck -> polish).

rpiv.$comment: Packs pin WorkflowModels.stages from these tiers via bindings; ladder is tier names, materialized to keys at run time. rpiv-wf run --model sets the run-wide default underneath pack pins.

verification.$comment: Pareto rule: tiers are cost bands, membership is measured. The evals harness already records per-model tokens and total_cost_usd (claude-host.ts) — cost coordinates come free; E1/E2 supply quality coordinates. Re-evaluate bindings as prices move; a cheaper model meeting a higher tier's bar promotes the binding, not the tier. 2026-10-20 lesson: stripping the harness (lean system prompt + --no-tools) cost 0.04-0.08 recall and introduced container drift — keep the harness, gate with validator+retry.
verification.promotion: E1 recall >= 0.90 with validator + 1 retry, then E2 edge overlap within 10% of reference (note: no arm has cleared 0.90 under single-reference recall; revisit the metric — quote-overlap recall — before treating the bar as failed)
verification.reference_set: claims table + contradiction-graph.json from run pi-plugin-ecosystem-skills-e7d4aa
verification.pareto_note: DeepSeek-flash thesis test: if it clears the large bar on extract-shaped stages at small cost, it does not become 'large' — it becomes the small binding for those stages, and the frontier moves.
